name: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited
summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited is an apparel retailer in India selling ultra-premium and high-quality sarees for weddings, parties and daily wear, plus ethnic fashion for middle-income shoppers. Its value segment covers fusion and Western wear and lehengas for women, men and children. It trades from several store formats, such as Kalamandir and KLM Fashion Mall. It was founded in 2005.
